name: Beam extraction, transport and installation (ridgeback2)

formation.note: base planar pose [x, y, yaw] in the payload planar frame

gates.note: closed from the moment the cart leaves its start position until it has left the aisle

load_sharing.note: weighted minimum-norm distribution; the internal wrench is defined relative to it

bounds.note: declared admissible bounds checked by the audit; clearance excludes the supports the payload rests on. Grasp force: the 100 N range of the UR10e wrist sensor less the weight of the clamp it also carries (11.8 N), rounded down; grasp moment: its 10 N m range. Tipping margin: distance of the centre of pressure from the triangle of the two rear wheels and the front rocker pivot.

declared: Task data designed by tools/build_mission.py from the physical records and the listed choices.

choices.turn_search: scan of the corner on a 0.15 m grid at every heading (mission.route.bottleneck_turn)
